method: Viewed all nine final original screenshots: paired context/front/oblique, tree-off, night and mobile. Geometry/direction reports supplement views.
observations: Default east-end window grid is replaced by three solid rail bands and photo-positioned doors/windows.
Context keeps the exterior stair, annex roof and neighboring blocks unchanged.
Oblique view reveals thin deck edges and end returns; near-frontal/mobile depth contrast remains modest under the existing lighting.
Tree-off state preserves building geometry; night glass remains visible.
limitations: Do not claim the normal correction cured the flat-looking lighting: exported materials are double-sided, and views remain similar before/after the direction fix.
Explicit corridor depth and correct outward/up/down normals are established by source/base/near rays, not screenshots alone.
Dimensions, hidden arrangement and material shades remain estimates.
